object.Title: Adoration of the Magi
object.Medium: crayon (?) on slightly textured, moderately thick, cream wove paper
object.Inscriptions: ""I. Patrois"" in charcoal, lower left, recto; ""48g"" (?) in graphite, upper right, verso; ""44"" in graphite, bottom edge, verso
object.Description: For the latest information about this object, Adoration of the Magi, visit the Online Collection of the Walters Art Museum.
object.Provenance: William T. Walters, Baltimore, 1865, by purchase [from the artist, George A. Lucas as agent]; Henry Walters, Baltimore, 1894, by inheritance; Walters Art Museum, 1931, by bequest.
object.MuseumLocation: To learn whether this object is now on view, and in which gallery, visit https://purl.thewalters.org/art/37.1401
